+---
+## What
+Source: ../FoundationModelsDecision/plan.md section 7, R1.
+
+- In `Package.swift`, add the package `git@github.com:swissarmyhammer/FoundationModelsDecision.git`, branch `main` (SSH URL, the same form as the FoundationModelsExtras dependency). Add a comment that tells why the package is a dependency.
+- Add the products `FoundationModelsDecision` and `FoundationModelsDecisionPooled` to the dependencies of the main target `FoundationModelsRouter`.
+- Add `FoundationModelsDecision` to the dependencies of the test target `FoundationModelsRouterTests`, if the tests need it.
+- Update `Package.resolved`. Before `swift package update`, stop the sourcekit-lsp of this repository and use `--manifest-cache local` (see the memory note "sourcekit-lsp and checkouts").
+- Check that `IntegrationTests/Package.swift` still resolves (it depends on the root package).
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] `swift build` passes with no new warnings.
+- [ ] `Package.resolved` pins FoundationModelsDecision at the origin/main head (496e1a0 or later).
+- [ ] A source file of the main target can `import FoundationModelsDecisionPooled` and refer to `PooledDecisionModel`.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] Add `Tests/FoundationModelsRouterTests/DecisionDependencyTests.swift` with one test that makes `GenericPromptFormat()` and checks that `DecisionSession` and `PooledDecisionModel` types are reachable (a compile-level check).
+- [ ] Run `swift build` and `swift test` once. All tests pass.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass. #decision
\ No newline at end of file
